model.notes: Two take rules that refine the crowd-short takes: one adds a 24h pump filter to the dual-venue retail-short rule, which tested near p 0.055; the other extends the accepted retail-versus-top-trader divergence rule and excludes 25x, where the INIT matches floored. One skip rule broadens the long-chasing skip. I added no new short skips, because last week's floor hits (BIGTIME, SSV, INIT, KERNEL) are already covered by the accepted live-pump and leverage rules, and the post-crash short and relief-rally cases were mixed winners and losers with no stable split.

accepted_now: Skip 20x+ shorts while both the last hour (+1% or more) and the last 4h (+1.5% or more) are still rising.

new.why: Open interest is unwinding while the coin's price stalls or dips and BTC is steady. Longs are leaving without a squeeze forcing a bounce. Entering after the unwind should mean less upside fuel, so adverse excursion stays small and a 3% stop can survive.
Shorts covered (the crowd shifted toward short-covering) and the price already squeezed up since the signal. Buying flow is now fading. The squeeze is spent, so we short its top with a short stop.
A burst of activity lifted the price, but buy share is back at or below half. The buying climax is exhausting itself, so we enter near the local high and adverse excursion is limited.
Funding has flipped positive while open interest builds: longs are crowding in and paying to hold. BTC is not helping. Late longs are vulnerable, which suits a short with a tight stop.

patterns.notes: The only close tercile that held in both halves is a high name_floor_share. The close rules build on it, adding a market change (open interest rebuilding, BTC turning up with buying). On exits, extreme fear and positive funding are the only states where a short stop (2%) gained versus the book in both halves. The entry rules target exhaustion and unwind states (open interest falling, a squeeze already done, a buying burst fading, crowded longs) so that a 2-3% stop is not cut, consistent with the last search where only the 3% stop with oi_1h held.
